description: Apply bounded planar PD force feedback to move a MuJoCo puck into a target region under moderate dynamics and initial-state variation.
prerequisites: MuJoCo 3.13 or a compatible 3.x version is installed.
Puck x/y position and velocity and target x/y position are observable.
Mass scale is within 0.4–1.8 of nominal, sliding friction within 0.2–1.4, and initial offset within ±0.15 m.
Execution is in the packaged planar simulation environment.
procedure: Read position and velocity at every simulation step.
Compute PD force from target error and velocity.
Clamp the force magnitude to 8 N.
Apply the force at the puck center of mass for 700 steps, then settle for 300 steps.
Evaluate completion, error, path, time, contacts, bounds, and numerical stability.
known_limits: Validated only in the packaged planar MuJoCo model.
Observation noise, delay, obstacles, and actuation saturation beyond 8 N were not tested.
